subject: Conditional model placement guarantee for Ambassador pilot
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Conditional model placement guarantee for Ambassador pilot

Hi Irene and Ben,

Quick context: Ambassador Financial (Priya and Alex copied below) are two weeks from a pilot kickoff and legal + infra requirements have them insisting on a "model placement guarantee" — they need an assurance that, for the pilot window, the model instances serving their tenant will not be moved off a specified region/GPU pool and that keys and telemetry remain within the dedicated tenancy.

They've made it explicit this is a gating item for the POC approval and potential committed capacity in Q3. Ben and I pushed for a scoped ask: not full Dedicated, but a short-term conditional placement + audit hook for the pilot (6 weeks). Attached is a one-page MVP requirements doc from their side.

Ask: could Product/Eng evaluate whether we can:
- provide a short-lived placement pinning (model residency) for an individual tenant for a fixed pilot window,
- expose a simple telemetry/audit endpoint showing instance IDs and region,
- add a limited CMK key policy to ensure keys are customer-owned for the pilot period

If this is non-starter, we need a firm no and rationale so I can push alternate workarounds with Ambassador. If doable, we need rough level-of-effort and earliest sprint window we could target.

Thanks — low-latency here; they expect an answer before next Tuesday.

Best,
Monica
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(415) 555-0126

Attachment: AMB_MVP_requirements.pdf (1 page, summary of pilot asks)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conditional model placement guarantee for Ambassador pilot

Monica — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. High level reaction:

- Short-lived placement pinning is technically possible but non-trivial. We can force affinity to a pool and avoid auto-balancing for a tenant, but that increases operational risk and reduces packing efficiency.
- Telemetry/audit endpoint is straightforward: we can return active instance ids, region, and image/hash. That we can scope to tenant-level tokens.
- Customer CMK for pilot is a policy + integration ask (Key rotation and access control). Works, but will need Security review.

To give a better LOE I need:
1) whether the pilot requires exclusive GPU hosts (no co-tenancy) or just placement affinity to a pool,
2) expected QPS/TPU profile for the pilot (tokens/sec typical and peak),
3) whether Ambassador needs the model version pinned or they accept a compatible variant fallback.

If we do affinity (not exclusive hosts), I estimate a small spike: ~3 engineer-weeks (runtime + deploy config + limited ops playbook) and an additional security engineer day for CMK gating. Exclusive hosts doubles the work and needs capacity planning.

If Ben/Monica can confirm the three items above I can route to infra and get a sprint-window estimate.

—Irene
Product Manager, Serving & Runtime
irene.choi@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Conditional model placement guarantee for Ambassador pilot

Looping in the customer to answer Irene's questions directly and to underscore urgency. Priya / Alex — short answers inline:

1) Co-tenancy: Legal's ask is that no other tenant share the exact physical hosts during the pilot. They'd accept a placement-affinity model if we can demonstrate the host set is dedicated for the pilot window. So effectively exclusive hosts for 6 weeks.
2) QPS profile: baseline 60 tokens/sec, peak 450 tokens/sec (bursty evenings), estimated 1.4M tokens/day during peak test days.
3) Model pinning: they want the model version pinned for the pilot; compatibility fallbacks only with explicit written consent.

Monica — attaching the mutual action plan we shared with them earlier (Ambassador_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx). Legal ops have already drafted a short addendum for the pilot and want technical confirmation before they sign.

If exclusive hosts are a hard no, we need an explicit alternative that we can present to legal today. Customer is indicating this is a gating item for the commercial commitment.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

(650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-02T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conditional model placement guarantee for Ambassador pilot

Thanks for laying this out — timely and important. I spoke to Infra and Platform leads this morning. Short summary and next steps: 

- Exclusive hosts for a single-tenant pilot is technically achievable but will require a short capacity carve-out and an ops runbook for manual placement + warm-up. It's operationally risky at scale but acceptable for a 6-week pilot with signoff.
- We need a signed pilot addendum by legal (Ben, can you attach once ready) and a security review window for CMK policies (Irene, please slot security review for this week).
- LOE: treating this as a high-priority carve-out, Eng can allocate a small focused effort: 4 engineer-weeks (runtime + scheduler pinning + audit endpoint + ops playbook) and 1 security engineer day. That matches Irene's ballpark with a small buffer for eks/k8s scheduling edge-cases.
- Proposed timeline: target a Canary in sprint 13 (starting 2026-06-21) with pilot-ready infrastructure by 2026-07-05 if we get signoff and capacity by 2026-06-10.

Monica — please confirm: will Ambassador sign the addendum and provide the official CMK request by 2026-06-09? If yes, I'll commit the sprint slot and loop in Infra leads for capacity planning. If no, we should prepare an alternative: provide affinity but not exclusive hosts + an enhanced telemetry package and an elevated support SL; we'll need to present tradeoffs to the customer.

Marissa Cole
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
